blocking_prerequisite: Confirmed: at 120 DPI / scale 1.25 the identity-bound capture was refused three times, each with a 43/49 display cross-check against the required 45, and no PNG was written. Not diagnosed: why the sample grids disagree. A DPI-virtualization explanation (harness-side logical geometry versus physical PrintWindow pixels) is consistent with the observed 1.25 arithmetic and the determinism, but the probe record carries no compared rectangles and no independent coordinate-transform or frame-accounting separation exists, so the cause stays INFERENCE / NOT_DIAGNOSED. Producing 120 DPI pixel evidence therefore needs a capture path whose coordinate frame is proven at fractional scale; that is existing verification code outside this slice's authorized change scope and was not modified, and the product was not changed to work around it.
